inputs: LlamaParse raw Markdown, JSON, and rendered DOM
service raw Markdown, JSON, and rendered DOM
review_method.rule: Printed text, visibly encoded chart marks, region geometry, and explicit connector arrowheads are source truth. Generated prose descriptions, interpolated chart values, and inferred relationships are baseline model observations and cannot independently establish a service regression.
review_method.analyzer_limitation: The current aggregate visual-origin proxy combines Llama semantic descriptions/structured chart reconstructions with service OCR. Those review_required proxy rows are not OCR-to-OCR comparisons and must not be promoted to release-blocking regressions without region-level source review.
review_method.hash_binding: Every row binds the source PDF, retained page render, and Llama reference JSON used during review.

adjudication.source_truth: The region visibly prints title, region legend, y-axis ticks, selected years, Annual total, and source note. Individual annual/1H values are encoded only by bar geometry and are not printed as the exhaustive Llama table claims.
adjudication.service_result: Source-grounded chart type and explicit labels are retained after VIS-RES-CAPTION-ROUTING-001; no inferred values are emitted.
adjudication.remaining_gap: Explicit chart structure/label normalization remains incomplete; Llama's exhaustive value matrix is not accepted as source truth.

adjudication.source_truth: The six panels visibly print technology labels, units, axes, years, and percentage callouts. Many exact Llama table values are reconstructed from bar heights and some disagree with visible geometry.
adjudication.service_result: Chart type, exact region, OCR evidence, and explicit labels are retained; no interpolated values are serialized.
adjudication.remaining_gap: Noisy rotated OCR and missing panel/axis semantics remain genuine.

adjudication.source_truth: The two small service regions are page-edge/decorative fragments, not independent semantic document visuals.
The Llama proxy contains a semantic logo phrase while the service proxy aggregates ordinary body and flowchart OCR across four pages. It is not an equivalent-region OCR comparison.
The page-3 raster flowchart is one visual region in both systems. Service now refines it to diagram; exact image-type counts therefore do not express a coverage loss.
The source contains a page-3 flowchart with explicit node labels and connectors.
adjudication.service_result: Public JSON now exposes one diagram region with 184 label occurrences and no fabricated topology. Its 802-character approved OCR occurs exactly once in JSON, raw Markdown, canonical Markdown, and rendered DOM; the external caption is separately once-only.
adjudication.remaining_gap: Explicit connector topology remains safely unresolved.

adjudication.source_truth: Llama descriptions of the Raspberry Pi board and pinout include semantic identities and explanations that are not printed in the figures. The service correctly does not invent them.

adjudication.remaining_gap: Pin labels are incomplete/noisy and diagram structure remains unmodeled; this requires a separate source-grounded diagram detector, not a caption guess.
